# PLAN — iteration 3
## Current state assessment
The baseline is timing-feasible at 7 LUTs and 9 FFs, so this iteration must strictly reduce LUTs to improve the objective. Iteration 1 narrowed the counter and iteration 2 changed its wrap behavior; both were rejected because they did not preserve all defined behavior. The counter must remain 32 bits, and its exact wrap at 255 and registered PWM output must be preserved.

## Hypothesis
Replacing the 32-bit conditional wrap mux with a 32-bit increment and correction of only bit 8 at count 255 may reduce LUT use while preserving the counter’s behavior from every state.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the 32-bit counter and synchronous active-high reset unchanged. Replace the `if (counter == 32'd255) counter <= 32'd0; else counter <= counter + 32'd1;` update with an unconditional 32-bit increment whose bit 8 is suppressed only when the current counter equals 255; the other incremented bits already match the required wrapped zero value at that count. Preserve the existing registered `pwm_out <= (counter < {24'd0, duty})` expression and reset behavior; do not narrow the counter or add latency. The expected LUT reduction is modest and must be established by retained routed metrics against the 7-LUT incumbent, with all fixed verification and timing gates passing.
